page.overview:
Who is Orla Richese?

Orla Richese is the wife of Ferdinand Richese and mother of Pruwet Richese.

Orla came to the Corrinos' with her husband, son, and daughter so her son could be married to Princess Ynez Corrino. The engagement ceremony went well, but at the engagement party, Pruwet pulled out a thinking machine toy, startling others as the technology was prohibited. When Ynez defended him, Javicco decided they could overlook it and the party continued.

Orla went with her husband and daughter when they learned Pruwet had been killed. Ferdinand knew there was more to the story than the Corrinos were telling them, but the Corrinos said nothing more about it. When Valya came, she gave them her condolences, but Javicco said that contrary to what they'd heard, there was no suspect in his death. However, later, Javicco had Desmond Hart, who had killed Pruwet, use the same power on Ferdinand to manipulate him into continuing his promised support. Orla begged Javicco to stop him and he did, only to tell them to go home, bury their son, and never tell anyone what had happened.
